text-primary.$description: Default text inside a .ds-tone-raised scope; restores text.primary even when the scope sits in an inverse or brand tone.

text-muted.$description: Secondary text inside a .ds-tone-raised scope; restores text.muted.

link.$description: Link text inside a .ds-tone-raised scope; restores text.link.

link-hover.$description: Link text on hover inside a .ds-tone-raised scope.

text-accent.$description: Accent text inside a .ds-tone-raised scope; restores text.accent.

accent-border.$description: Accent marker inside a .ds-tone-raised scope; restores accent.border.

focus-ring.$description: Keyboard focus ring inside a .ds-tone-raised scope; 3:1 against surface.raised.

border-control.$description: Control boundary (checkbox, radio) inside a .ds-tone-raised scope; 3:1 against surface.raised.

bg.$description: Primary action fill inside a .ds-tone-raised scope.

bg-hover.$description: Primary action fill on hover inside a .ds-tone-raised scope.

bg-active.$description: Primary action fill when pressed inside a .ds-tone-raised scope.

fg.$description: Text and icons on the primary action fill inside a .ds-tone-raised scope.

bg.$description: Secondary action fill inside a .ds-tone-raised scope.

bg-hover.$description: Secondary action fill on hover inside a .ds-tone-raised scope.

bg-active.$description: Secondary action fill when pressed inside a .ds-tone-raised scope.

fg.$description: Text and icons on the secondary action fill inside a .ds-tone-raised scope.

border.$description: Secondary action outline inside a .ds-tone-raised scope; 3:1 against its fills and the surface.

text-muted.$description: Secondary text inside a .ds-tone-inverse scope; replaces text.muted there.

link.$description: Link text inside a .ds-tone-inverse scope; replaces text.link there.

link-hover.$description: Link text on hover inside a .ds-tone-inverse scope.

text-accent.$description: Accent text inside a .ds-tone-inverse scope; replaces text.accent there.

accent-border.$description: Accent marker inside a .ds-tone-inverse scope; replaces accent.border there; 3:1 against surface.inverse.

focus-ring.$description: Keyboard focus ring inside a .ds-tone-inverse scope; 3:1 against surface.inverse.

border-control.$description: Control boundary (checkbox, radio) inside a .ds-tone-inverse scope; 3:1 against surface.inverse.

bg.$description: Primary action fill inside a .ds-tone-inverse scope; 3:1 against surface.inverse.

bg-hover.$description: Primary action fill on hover inside a .ds-tone-inverse scope.

bg-active.$description: Primary action fill when pressed inside a .ds-tone-inverse scope.

fg.$description: Text and icons on the primary action fill inside a .ds-tone-inverse scope.

bg.$description: Secondary action fill inside a .ds-tone-inverse scope (same as the surface, so the button reads as an outline).

bg-hover.$description: Secondary action fill on hover inside a .ds-tone-inverse scope.

bg-active.$description: Secondary action fill when pressed inside a .ds-tone-inverse scope.

fg.$description: Text and icons on the secondary action fill inside a .ds-tone-inverse scope.

border.$description: Secondary action outline inside a .ds-tone-inverse scope; 3:1 against its fills and the surface.

text-muted.$description: Secondary text inside a .ds-tone-brand scope; replaces text.muted there.

link.$description: Link text inside a .ds-tone-brand scope; replaces text.link there.

link-hover.$description: Link text on hover inside a .ds-tone-brand scope.

fg.$description: Text and icons on the primary action fill inside a .ds-tone-brand scope.

bg.$description: Secondary action fill inside a .ds-tone-brand scope (same as the surface, so the button reads as an outline).
